在交接件中加入「Wazuh FIM：資產、信任邊界與測試資料」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：為測試設定目錄建立路徑、大小、內容雜湊與核准變更單；比較內容改變、只改mtime、檔案移除三種合成事件。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：為測試設定目錄建立路徑、大小、內容雜湊與核准變更單；比較內容改變、只改mtime、檔案移除三種合成事件。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver baseline inventory, three event classes and approved/unapproved disposition table.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Wazuh FIM：Assets, trust boundaries and test fixtures: Inventory path, size, content hash and approved change record for a test configuration directory; compare content changes, mtime-only changes and deletion. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Inventory path, size, content hash and approved change record for a test configuration directory; compare content changes, mtime-only changes and deletion. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。為測試設定目錄建立路徑、大小、內容雜湊與核准變更單；比較內容改變、只改mtime、檔案移除三種合成事件。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Inventory path, size, content hash and approved change record for a test configuration directory; compare content changes, mtime-only changes and deletion. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 為測試設定目錄建立路徑、大小、內容雜湊與核准變更單；比較內容改變、只改mtime、檔案移除三種合成事件。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.checkEn: Inventory path, size, content hash and approved change record for a test configuration directory; compare content changes, mtime-only changes and deletion. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Wazuh的檔案完整性監測可記錄檔案變化，需配合可信基準與變更背景。
knowledge.textEn: Wazuh file-integrity monitoring records file changes and requires a trusted baseline plus change context.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 為測試設定目錄建立路徑、大小、內容雜湊與核准變更單；比較內容改變、只改mtime、檔案移除三種合成事件。
knowledge.textEn: Inventory path, size, content hash and approved change record for a test configuration directory; compare content changes, mtime-only changes and deletion.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 順序讀取的理想掃描時間=總資料MiB/有效吞吐MiB每秒；metadata、雜湊CPU與小檔案開銷另算，雜湊變更不直接證明惡意。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal sequential scan time is total MiB divided by effective MiB/s; metadata, hashing CPU and small-file overhead are separate, and a hash change alone does not prove malice.
